risk_note: RV2 task (orders, identity, linking, admin index, app.module, apps/admin claims pages, contract and generated route tables): implements the admin claim review read endpoints of contract CT-24d, removing x-implementation planned from GET /admin/v1/claims (adminListClaims) and GET /admin/v1/claims/{claim_id} (adminGetClaim). orders/http/admin with OrdersAdminModule.forAdmin, mounted in the admin entry; AdminOperationGuard with order.claim, or user.lookup only when user_id is given (10403 otherwise); another user's claim and malformed ids answer like a missing one (20001); masked phone through a new identity port (3+4, BR-ID-33), handler display name through a new admin read port (display_name, else login name), evidence links through a new linking read-by-id port; no cross-module table reads. auto_matched first, counts over the other filters, q exact match. Contract loosening: evidence_level (list and detail), item evidence and evidence link scene may be null (submitted claims and legacy logs); the admin claims page accepts null. Reads write no audit. Rule tests (46, [AC-B1-10j#n]) written by Codex, red before the implementation, green after; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in two runs.
